svg.aria-label: CLCD-HRMS — the same app, three roles
svg.text: CLCD-HRMS — THE SAME APP, THREE ROLES
Dashed rows are this diagram’s annotation, not the app’s: in the product the item is simply not rendered.
A nineteenth item, Grants, is reserved for a director or principal investigator and appears in none of these three.
THE HOME EACH ROLE LANDS ON
Same route, different question being answered
An employee cannot reach Employees, Payroll, Onboarding, Assets,
Internship, Reports or Settings — and is never shown that they exist.
Row-Level Security in Postgres is default-deny and enforces the same
boundary, so the sidebar is not the protection: it is an honest picture of it.
Their home answers three questions about one person, not twenty-four.
